name: ast-search
description: Structural Python search via stdlib ast: defs, imports, call sites, name references, top-level symbols. Matches by syntax not text — immune to comments/strings false positives.
use_when: finding Python symbols/callers semantically instead of grepping

args.name: calls <path>
args.description: Call sites; --name required (matches dotted names like obj.m).

stdout: JSON array of {file, line, col, kind, name, context}.
notes: Python only. Unparseable files warn on stderr and are skipped.
